title: hpatch diagnostic
body: Intended action: replace two known multiline blocks in an existing Go file while making follow-up compile fixes. Observed behavior: I used the fixed heredoc form as though it could carry an exact multiline text target, so HPATCH parsed it as a targetless initializer and rejected the complete script. Impact: no workspace changes occurred and one corrected resubmission was needed. Smallest useful improvement: include a concise parser hint on this error stating that heredoc mutation values require a row/range target and multiline text targets must be JSON-quoted on the command line.

title: hpatch diagnostic
body: Intended action: atomically add RangeStream plumbing and implementation across the permitted Go files. Observed behavior: the first HPATCH/2 script was rejected because `add` destinations targeting each function's closing-brace row inserted before that row, producing syntax errors; the diagnostics clearly showed duplicated/misplaced closing braces. Impact: no workspace changes occurred, and I had to resubmit the complete multi-file script with the following blank lines as insertion destinations. Smallest useful improvement: clarify in the `add ROW` documentation and syntax diagnostic that insertion is before the target row, especially for the common “add a function after this function” case.

title: hpatch diagnostic
body: Intended action: atomically add the RangeStream production path across the eight permitted files. Observed behavior: one insertion target in server/proxy/grpcproxy/kv.go used a mistyped row hash (`27:42f1` instead of the already-read `27:42f4`), causing the entire edit to reject and require hpatch recovery. Impact: one extra recovery call; the workspace remained unchanged until recovery succeeded. Smallest useful improvement: when a row number matches but its supplied hash is absent and the current-line hash is shown, support an opt-in exact current-line correction in the original call or make the mismatch more visually prominent before submission.

title: hpatch diagnostic
body: Intended action: replace two recently added RangeStream blocks to correct CountOnly semantics and preserve stream Send errors. Observed behavior: HPATCH rejected both edits as row-stale because I used reconstructed row hashes rather than the current hashes returned by the prior edit; recovery succeeded after a focused reread. Impact: one extra read and recovery call, with no partial workspace changes. Smallest useful improvement: surface final-state row identities for all lines in newly inserted multiline blocks so immediate follow-up edits do not require rereading them.
